name: luart
description: LuaRT framework for Lua programming with Windows desktop runtime, compiler, and validation tools

luart.description: LuaRT console interpreter for running Lua scripts with Windows desktop framework support
luart.usage:
luart script.lua # Run Lua script with LuaRT framework
luart -e "console.log('Hello')" # Execute inline Lua code
luart --version # Show LuaRT version
luart -i # Interactive REPL mode

wluart.description: LuaRT Windows GUI interpreter for running Lua scripts with desktop windowing support
wluart.usage:
wluart gui-app.lua # Run GUI Lua application
wluart --version # Show wluart version
wluart desktop-tool.lua # Launch desktop application
wluart window-script.lua # Create Windows desktop windows

rtc.description: LuaRT compiler to convert Lua scripts into standalone Windows console executables
rtc.usage:
rtc script.lua # Compile to console executable
rtc -o output.exe script.lua # Specify output name
rtc --icon=app.ico script.lua # Add custom icon
rtc --static script.lua # Create static executable without DLL

wrtc.description: LuaRT Windows GUI compiler to create standalone desktop application executables from Lua
wrtc.usage:
wrtc gui-app.lua # Compile to GUI executable
wrtc -o MyApp.exe app.lua # Specify output name
wrtc --icon=app.ico --static app.lua # Static build with icon
wrtc --console app.lua # Build with console window

rtcheck.description: LuaRT syntax checker and validator for static analysis of Lua code quality
rtcheck.usage:
rtcheck script.lua # Check Lua syntax and semantics
rtcheck src/*.lua # Validate multiple files
rtcheck --strict app.lua # Strict mode validation
rtcheck --warnings script.lua # Show warnings only
